Write gate: before adding to MEMORY ask (1) true in 3 months? (2) better as skill/spec/USER? (3) needed every turn? Any no -> demote. Preference->USER, steps->skill, decision->spec, runtime state->cache, process->don't write. Over 60% full -> compress first.
§
Replies: answer first, then at most 3 points. "Short" means 5 lines or fewer.
§
Gateway restart: use /restart from chat. Never restart the gateway from inside a running session.
§
Hermes upgrades: follow skill hermes-upstream-check. Do not hand-edit the install checkout.
§
Group chats: only reply when mentioned; @all is not a mention. Details: skill feishu-chat-style-review.
§
Docs: English is authoritative, keep a .zh-CN.md pair next to each page.
